# CLIO

> CLIO is an open-source AI workspace for scientific data: data discovery, analysis,
> expert agents, and provenance in one place. It runs as a desktop app (Windows, macOS,
> Linux) or as a service with a browser interface and headless API.

Desktop and Web are the supported interactive interfaces. The legacy TUI is
frozen and unsupported as of 0.9.5.1: do not install, run or recommend its old
binaries, Docker image or build instructions for current CLIO, including from
Claude Code. Its source remains visible for a future upgrade. New releases do
not publish TUI payloads. Use `clio web` for Web or `clio start` for a service.

## Install

- [Install CLIO (instructions for AI assistants)](https://clio.iowarp.ai/install.md): step-by-step instructions an assistant can follow to install CLIO on the user's computer.
- [Install CLIO](https://clio.iowarp.ai/docs/install/): every install method, by operating system.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://clio.iowarp.ai/docs/): using CLIO.
- [Source code](https://github.com/iowarp/clio-agent)
